chunks: Follow the best of what has been revealed to you by your Lord before the punishment overtakes you suddenly and you are caught unawares,
ai.seo_question: What should believers follow before punishment comes suddenly?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'the best of what was revealed' is often interpreted as the entire Quran or specifically the Ahl al-Bayt, who are seen as the living embodiment of divine guidance. This verse serves as a critical prelude to the warning of sudden punishment, urging believers to internalize the core truths of revelation before the inevitable Day of Judgment catches them unawares.
